# danaher-on-carter-palermos-2016
- **URL:** https://philosophicaldisquisitions.blogspot.com/2017/05/extended-cognition-and-possibility-of.html · **Accessed:** 2026-09-16 · **For:** v1 review, Phase 2
- **What it establishes:** John Danaher's reconstruction of Carter & Palermos, JAPA 2:4 (2016): compromising an integrated cognitive artifact is personal assault; depends on dynamical-systems integration; fungibility objection; no privacy/surveillance discussion.
- **Key passages:** "Intentional harm to a part of a person which is responsible for her mental and other faculties constitutes personal assault."
- **Reliability:** Secondary (philosopher's blog summary); independent.
- **Relevance to this project:** Report §3, §4′(C).
